item.title: AI Errors, Silent Deletions: Mamata Banerjee alleges discrepancies in West Bengal voter roll clean-up
item.description: Mamata Banerjee claims 54 lakh voter names were deleted in West Bengal using “BJP-devised AI tools.” With women and genuine voters allegedly hit hardest, questions are rising over transparency and fairness in the SIR process.

item.title: Viral: From Dating App To Dream Job; The Hinge Match That Changed Everything
item.description: A casual Hinge chat turned into a career breakthrough for a final-year student, leading to a ₹18 LPA job offer. From backlogs to big tech how one swipe unexpectedly changed everything.

item.title: China Rejects India’s Objection, Claims Rights Over Shaksgam Valley Projects
item.description: China has dismissed India’s objections to infrastructure projects in the Shaksgam Valley, calling it its sovereign territory. India has strongly opposed the move, terming the area illegally occupied and CPEC a violation of its sovereignty.

item.title: Unreasonable Power: Why Musk is angry over Apple-Google AI deal? Explained
item.description: Elon Musk has slammed Apple’s AI partnership with Google, warning it could lead to an “unreasonable concentration of power.” As Apple leans on Gemini to fix Siri, is Big Tech becoming too powerful for its own good?

item.title: Weather News: Bone-Chilling Winter Tightens Grip on North India as Dense Fog, Cold Wave Disrupt Life
item.description: Severe winter conditions continue across north India as dense fog, cold wave and frost disrupt daily life. Several regions reported near-zero visibility, while IMD forecasts snowfall and rain due to an active western disturbance in coming days.

item.title: Gold-Silver Price Today: Gold Prices Inch Higher in India on January 14 as Silver Holds Steady
item.description: Gold prices in India rose marginally on January 14, 2026, driven by global trends and domestic demand, while silver prices remained stable. Check the latest city-wise gold and silver rates amid ongoing market and economic fluctuations.

item.description: Indian stock markets closed lower after a volatile session as geopolitical tensions, record-high gold prices and foreign selling weighed on sentiment. Experts warn of continued volatility while highlighting key stocks to watch amid cautious global cues.

item.title: Iran Protests Update: US on High Alert as Iran Crisis Deepens, Citizens Told to Leave Immediately
item.description: Tensions escalate in Iran amid violent protests and harsh crackdowns. The US has issued an emergency alert, asking its citizens to leave Iran immediately as security worsens, flights get suspended, and fears of military escalation grow.

item.title: Deadly rail accident in Thailand after crane falls on train, killed 22 Passengers
item.description: A passenger train derailed in Thailand after a construction crane fell onto it, killing at least 22 people and injuring over 30. The tragic accident occurred in Nakhon Ratchasima province, prompting massive rescue operations.
